diseases.title: Rice Blast (Dhaan ka Jhonka Rog)
diseases.description: Spindle-shaped lesions on leaves with grayish centers. Spreads rapidly in high humidity conditions. Reported in Kishanpur block farms.

metadata.symptoms: Spindle-shaped lesions on leaves with grayish centers. Spreading rapidly due to high humidity.
metadata.organicTreatment: Spray Neem oil formulation (3,000 ppm) at 3 ml per liter of water. Ensure proper spacing between rows.
metadata.chemicalTreatment: Spray Tricyclazole 75 WP at 0.6 grams per liter of water. Avoid water logging.
metadata.preventiveMeasures: Destroy previous crop residues. Do not apply excessive nitrogen fertilizer.
metadata.outbreakIndicator: 3 nearby farms in Kishanpur reported Rice Blast in the last 48 hours.

diseases.title: Cotton Leaf Curl (Kapas ka Patta Marod Rog)
diseases.description: Upward curling of leaf margins, thick veins on leaves, stunted plant growth in cotton crops.

metadata.symptoms: Upward curling of leaf margins, thick veins on leaves, stunted plant growth.
metadata.organicTreatment: Introduce ladybird beetles to control whiteflies vector. Spray garlic-chili extract.
metadata.chemicalTreatment: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8 SL at 0.5 ml per liter of water to control vector.
metadata.preventiveMeasures: Use resistant cotton hybrids. Eliminate weed hosts near field bunds.
metadata.outbreakIndicator: 1 farm in Laxmipur block reported leaf curl vector outbreak.

diseases.title: Early Blight (Ageti Jhulsa Rog)
diseases.description: Concentric dark brown circular spots appearing first on older leaves, forming a target board pattern.

metadata.symptoms: Concentric dark brown circular spots appearing first on older leaves, forming a target board pattern.
metadata.organicTreatment: Mulch soil surface with crop residue. Spray copper hydroxide or bio-pesticide Trichoderma.
metadata.chemicalTreatment: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP at 2 grams per liter of water immediately.
metadata.preventiveMeasures: Ensure crop rotation. Water roots directly instead of overhead leaf sprinkling.

diseases.title: Wheat Yellow Rust / Yellow Leaves (Gehun me Peeli Pattiyan / Peela Rog)
diseases.description: Yellowing of wheat leaves (peeli pattiyan) caused by Nitrogen deficiency, water logging, or Yellow Rust (Puccinia striiformis) fungal infection.

metadata.symptoms: Yellow stripes or complete yellowing of wheat leaves (peeli pattiyan), stunted growth, reduced tillering.
metadata.organicTreatment: Apply organic cow compost (gobhar khad) and neem oil spray (3 ml/liter). Ensure proper field drainage to clear stagnant water.
metadata.chemicalTreatment: Apply Urea (25kg/acre) for nitrogen deficiency. Spray Propiconazole 25 EC (1 ml per liter of water) for fungal yellow rust.
metadata.preventiveMeasures: Avoid over-irrigation, maintain field drainage, use resistant wheat seed varieties (e.g., HD-2967, DBW-187), and apply balanced NPK fertilizers.
metadata.outbreakIndicator: Reported in North Indian wheat growing belts during winter/humid season.

diseases.title: Aphids / Mustard-Wheat Aphid (Chepa / Maho / Keede)
diseases.description: Small sap-sucking insects causing leaf yellowing, curling, and honeydew mold on crops.

metadata.symptoms: Clusters of tiny green/black aphids on undersides of leaves and stems, leaf yellowing, sticky honeydew emission.
metadata.organicTreatment: Spray Neem oil (3,000 ppm) at 3-5 ml per liter of water with soap solution, or release ladybird beetles.
metadata.chemicalTreatment: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8 SL at 0.5 ml per liter of water or Dimethoate 30 EC at 1.5 ml per liter.
metadata.preventiveMeasures: Install yellow sticky traps (10-12 traps per acre), monitor field weekly, preserve natural predators.

weather.title: Weather Alert Thresholds for Farmers
weather.description: Threshold values used by KrishiMitra to raise weather-specific farming alerts including danger and caution warnings.

alerts.title: Thunderstorm Warning
alerts.description: Lightning and electrical storm active. Seek shelter indoors. Postpone using field machinery.

alerts.title: Heatwave Alert
alerts.description: Extreme temperatures exceeding 40°C. Avoid outdoor labor in peak hours. Ensure adequate crop watering.

alerts.title: Cold Wave Alert
alerts.description: Temperatures dropped below 10°C. Cover frost-sensitive crops or trigger light night irrigation.

alerts.title: Heavy Rain Warning
alerts.description: Heavy localized showers expected. Clear drainage pathways to avoid field flooding.

alerts.title: Strong Wind Warning
alerts.description: High wind velocity exceeding 25 km/h. Postpone foliar spraying; secure crop supports.

alerts.title: Fog Warning
alerts.description: Dense fog limiting visibility. Exercise caution during early morning operations.

weather.title: Crop-Specific Weather Advisory Structure
weather.description: JSON structure generated by Gemini AI for crop-specific weather farming recommendations.

metadata.generatedBy: Gemini AI (gemini-2.5-flash via Google Generative Language API)

advisoryFields.advisory: 2-sentence summary of crop health suggestions under current weather conditions
advisoryFields.watering: Irrigation guidelines based on humidity, temperature, and rain likelihood
advisoryFields.pesticide: Pesticide spray recommendations based on rain probability and wind speed
advisoryFields.fertilizer: Fertilizer advice based on weather impact on absorption
advisoryFields.harvest: Harvesting advice based on approaching storms or moisture levels

fertilizers.title: Urea (Nitrogen Fertilizer)
fertilizers.description: Primary nitrogen source fertilizer. Should not be applied before or during rain events to avoid wash-off and loss.

metadata.application: 25kg Nitrogen (Urea) per acre for Alluvial Clay-Loam soil
metadata.timing: Avoid application during rain probability above 50% or before expected heavy downpours
metadata.advisory: Rain showers expected for the next 24 hours. Postpone nitrogen/urea fertilizer applications. Keep drainage channels open in vegetable beds to prevent water logging.
metadata.weatherCondition: Do not apply in wet or waterlogged conditions

fertilizers.title: DAP (Phosphorus Fertilizer)
fertilizers.description: Di-Ammonium Phosphate - primary phosphorus and secondary nitrogen source for most crops.

metadata.application: 15kg Phosphorus (DAP) per acre for Alluvial Clay-Loam soil
metadata.timing: Apply in dry soil before sowing for best absorption
metadata.advisory: Avoid applying urea or top-dressing fertilizers when rain will wash it away.
metadata.weatherCondition: Apply during dry breaks in weather; avoid during rain

fertilizers.title: Organic Cow Compost (Gobhar Khad)
fertilizers.description: Farm yard manure / organic compost that improves soil organic carbon, water retention, and microbial activity.

metadata.application: Mix 5 tons organic cow compost (gobhar khad) per acre. For Black Clayey Soil: regular compost is sufficient.
metadata.timing: Apply before sowing season for best results
metadata.advisory: Alluvial soil organic matter is 0.62% (Low). Apply gobhar khad to improve fertility.
metadata.weatherCondition: Can be applied in any weather condition

fertilizers.title: Zinc Sulphate (Micronutrient)
fertilizers.description: Zinc micronutrient fertilizer used in Black Clayey Soil to enhance micronutrient availability.

metadata.application: Add 10kg Zinc Sulphate per acre to enhance micro-nutrients in Black Clayey Soil
metadata.timing: Apply during base fertilizer application before sowing
metadata.advisory: Soil health is highly rich in Black Clayey Soil. Add Zinc Sulphate to fill micronutrient gaps.

pesticides.title: Imidacloprid 17.8 SL (Cotton Whitefly Control)
pesticides.description: Systemic insecticide used to control whitefly vectors responsible for Cotton Leaf Curl disease.

pesticides.title: Mancozeb 75 WP (Tomato Early Blight Treatment)

pesticides.title: Trichoderma (Bio-Pesticide Fungal Control)

metadata.dosage: As per product label - typically 5-10 grams per liter of water
metadata.precautions: Store in cool place. Do not mix with chemical fungicides.
metadata.weatherConstraint: Best applied in humid conditions for spore germination; avoid strong UV sunlight
